1. **Establish the baseline.** Inspect the branch, commit and dirty changes read-only. Leave the colleague’s UI work untouched; do not stash, reset or rebase the shared checkout.

4. **Migrate one format at a time.** Treat each format’s serializer, dependent consumers and fixtures as one coherent contract change. From a recorded passing state, make the change, run its decisive compatibility and regression checks, and advance only after they pass. Keep each unit independently revertible in the isolated branch.
5. **Verify the final combination.** Run the complete serializer suite and relevant integration checks across all three migrated formats. Present baseline results before each format’s change and validation, followed by final integration results.

Use the agreed delivery policy; this sequence does not require three commits or a PR stack.
